/* Attd01Mapper.selectSchHistList */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.SCH_CD AS schCd , DATE_FORMAT(A.APPLY_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS applyDate
, CONCAT( A.FST_SCH_STR_TIME , '-' , A.FST_SCH_END_TIME ) AS fstSchTime , A.FST_SCH_BRK_MIN AS fstSchBrkMin , A.FST_BRK_STR_TIME AS fstBrkStrTime , A.FST_BRK_END_TIME AS fstBrkEndTime
, CONCAT( A.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME , '-' , A.SEC_SCH_END_TIME ) AS secSchTime , A.SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN AS secSchBrkMin , A.SEC_BRK_STR_TIME AS secBrkStrTime , A.SEC_BRK_END_TIME AS secBrkEndTime
, A.USE_YN AS useYn , A.INSERT_NO AS userId
, FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH( A.CMPNY_CD , 'USER_NM' , A.INSERT_NO , null ) AS userNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate
, A.PRE_FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS preFixedOtStrTime , A.PRE_FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS preFixedOtEndTime , A.FIXED_OT_STR_TIME AS fixedOtStrTime , A.FIXED_OT_END_TIME AS fixedOtEndTime FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.SCH_CD = #{schCd} ORDER BY A.CMPNY_CD, A.SITE_CD, A.HIST_IDX
